thesis: The episode explores the post-COVID-19 investing environment and distinguishes between 'navigators' and 'cartographers' in the context of CEO roles. It argues that while the current uncertainty causes companies with recent seed funding to recalibrate their runway, the market will eventually filter out 'tourists' to leave only true believers and entrepreneurs.
